english: The number of permutations $\sigma$ of $\{1,2,\ldots,8\}$ having exactly two fixed points (that is, exactly two values of $i$ with $\sigma(i)=i$), the two fixed points being consecutive integers, is
hindi: समुच्चय $\{1,2,\ldots,8\}$ के उन क्रमचयों $\sigma$ की संख्या, जिनके ठीक दो स्थिर बिन्दु हैं (अर्थात् $i$ के ठीक दो मानों के लिए $\sigma(i)=i$) तथा ये दोनों स्थिर बिन्दु क्रमागत पूर्णांक हैं, है
solution: Choose the fixed pair $\{k,k+1\}$, $1\leq k\leq7$: 7 ways
The other 6 numbers must have no fixed point: $D_{6}=720\left(\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{24}-\dfrac{1}{120}+\dfrac{1}{720}\right)=265$
solution_full: A permutation with exactly the fixed points $k$ and $k+1$ fixes these two numbers and moves every other number.
The pair of consecutive fixed points can be $\{1,2\},\{2,3\},\ldots,\{7,8\}$: 7 choices.
For a chosen pair, $\sigma$ permutes the remaining 6 numbers among themselves with no fixed point, i.e. as a derangement of 6 objects.
Different pairs give different sets of fixed points, so there is no overlap. The number is $7\cdot265=1855$. (Without the consecutive condition it would be $\binom{8}{2}\cdot265=7420$.)
originality_note: New: exactly-k-fixed-point counting where the fixed set must be a pair of consecutive integers, so the choice of the fixed set is a combinatorial count of its own (way 5). Closest known: permutations with exactly k fixed points, C(n,k) D(n-k). Different because: the fixed set is restricted, so the binomial factor is replaced by the number of consecutive pairs.

concept_use.De-arrangement: 'De-arrangement' of the six non-fixed numbers: none of them may stay in its place.
concept_use.Derangements: The count of those six is the derangement number D6 = 265 from the inclusion-exclusion formula.

Checked by enumerating all 8! permutations (1855), that 'exactly two fixed points' forces the other six to be deranged, and that 1855 is at (A) as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Choosing the consecutive fixed pair and deranging the other six numbers.
justification: Two standard steps (choose the fixed set, D6) with no insight; level 2 like the routine counting 2021-P2-Q1 (L2).
